catalog.title: Metro Pulse
catalog.author: simetro team
catalog.description: A neon transit-map loop shaped like a heartbeat pulse with clear terminal, transfer, and neighborhood station language.
catalog.palette_note: Midnight navy canvas, porcelain foreground, and five saturated route accents: magenta mainline, cyan river link, amber downtown transfer, mint garden branch, and violet pulse peak.
catalog.layout_note: Eight stations trace a wide left-to-right ECG silhouette: west approach, downtown beat, tall pulse peak, garden settle, east terminus, and a low return leg.
catalog.node_language_note: Circles mark terminals, diamonds mark transfers, squares mark neighborhood stops, the triangle marks the pulse peak, and the hexagon marks the central hub.
catalog.mover_path_note: Four movers start on long, differently colored route segments so the first frame shows traffic on the west inlet, central pulse, eastern glide, and south return.
catalog.review_note: Visual review target: 960x540 first-frame canvas; checked for v1 validity, transit-map palette separation, heartbeat silhouette, distinct node shapes/colors, and visible mover starts.
